support.contact.title: Contact us
support.contact.description: Have a question or a wholesale enquiry? Choose a topic and tell us how we can help.
support.feedback.title: Share your feedback
support.feedback.description: Tell us about your experience with the site and what you would like to see improved.
support.sampler.title: Build a six-piece sampler
support.sampler.description: Choose six pieces and send an enquiry. This does not place an order, add to your cart, or collect payment. Availability and details require confirmation.

support.story.title: Our story
support.story.intro: SolCacao brings together chocolate for individual tastes and a dedicated space for business gifting and custom enquiries.
support.story.body: Browse chocolate bars, truffles and seasonal selections. Explore the catalog by cacao percentage, origin and price, or build a sampler to share the pieces that interest you.
support.story.secondBody: The wholesale journey introduces custom confectionery, personalized packaging and white-label options. Use the customization form to describe your business requirements, or start with a wholesale enquiry through our contact page.
support.story.pending: Our approved brand story is being prepared. Team history, sourcing details and original process photography will be added when supplied and reviewed.
support.care.title: Product care
support.care.intro: Find the available product details and a clear place to ask questions about the chocolate you are considering.
support.care.body: Open a chocolate's catalog page to review its available description, ingredients and allergen information. If a detail is missing or unclear, include the product name when you contact us.
support.care.secondBody: For a question about storage, handling or packaging, choose General support on the contact form and describe the product and your question. For a business or customized selection, choose Wholesale enquiry. Product-specific instructions require confirmation from the team.
support.care.pending: Approved storage, handling, ingredient and allergen information has not yet been supplied. This page does not provide product safety guidance. Contact us with a product question.
support.content.photoNote: Illustrative stock photography; not a photograph of SolCacao operations or products.
